written.headline: Anthropic valued at over $1 trillion as CEO Dario Amodei shares philosophy
written.summary: Anthropic is worth more than $1 trillion as CEO Dario Amodei promotes his philosophy of the future. The company seeds these ideas with opinion-makers through essays, Slack memos, and talks.

written.headline: Scott Bessent says Jensen Huang's Nvidia return should await China probes
written.summary: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated that Jensen Huang's potential return as Nvidia's chief executive should depend on investigations into the company's China chip sales. Bessent also noted that Nvidia has yet to answer questions regarding the U.S. probe into alleged restricted AI chip sales to China.

written.headline: OpenAI shares internal perplexity data and proposes shared AI safety limits
written.summary: OpenAI Chief Scientist Jakub Pachocki published internal perplexity measurements for models starting with GPT-3.5 and proposed establishing perplexity as a common metric for industry safety standards. Perplexity measures how well a model predicts the next token on average, with lower scores indicating better predictions.

written.headline: Data centers emerge as a political flashpoint amid growing tech backlash
written.summary: Journalist Paris Marx examines the environmental and social impacts of the rapid generative AI data center buildout in his new book, Hyperscale. The expansion of these facilities has driven local community opposition and emerged as a political factor in recent midterm elections.

written.headline: Officials warn of more tech outages during AI infrastructure upgrades
written.summary: Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton and Microsoft President Brad Smith warned that further major tech outages are expected as global information infrastructure is upgraded for the AI age. Recent disruptions included a nationwide FAA ground stop, a multi-day Microsoft Outlook outage, and banking issues at JPMorgan Chase.
